test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 19 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following was hosted by IIT Mandi in June 2025, focusing on mental health applications?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mind, Brain, and Consciousness Conference**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Mind, Brain, and Consciousness Conference** was hosted by **IIT Mandi** in **June 2025**, specifically designed to address modern **mental health applications**.
 
• The conference served as a multi-disciplinary platform bringing together **neuroscientists**, **psychologists**, and **engineers** to discuss the **biological** and **psychological** aspects of the human mind.
 
• A primary focus was the integration of **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** and **Machine Learning (ML)** in developing **predictive models** for mental health disorders like **depression** and **generalized anxiety disorder**.
 
• The event highlighted the **Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Mandi's** leadership in **Cognitive Science** research within the **Himalayan region**.
 
• Researchers presented findings on **Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCI)**, showcasing how **wearable sensors** can assist in **real-time monitoring** of cognitive stress levels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **IIT Mandi (Himachal Pradesh):**
 
 
• Established in **2009**, it is one of the second-generation **IITs** located in the **Kamand Valley** of **Mandi district**.
 
• The institute has a dedicated **Center for Indian Knowledge Systems and Mental Health Applications (IKSMHA)**, which focuses on **scientific validation** of traditional practices.
 
 
 
• **Mental Health Statistics in India:**
 
 
• According to the **National Mental Health Survey (NMHS)**, nearly **150 million** Indians require mental health interventions, making conferences like this crucial for **public health policy**.
 
• The conference aligns with the **National Mental Health Programme (NMHP)** launched by the **Government of India** to provide affordable care.
 
 
 
• **Emerging Technologies:**
 
 
• **Neurofeedback:** A technique used to train **brain activity**, which was a major theme at the **2025** conference for treating **ADHD** and **PTSD**.
 
• **Digital Therapeutics (DTx):** Software-driven evidence-based interventions discussed during the summit to complement **pharmacological treatments**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Interdisciplinary Collaboration:** The event emphasized the **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020** goals by promoting **cross-disciplinary research** between **humanities** and **technology**.
 
• **Global Participation:** The **June 2025** session saw participation from over **500 delegates** representing **20 countries**, fostering international cooperation in **Consciousness Studies**.
 
• **IKS Validation:** A significant portion of the conference was dedicated to **Yoga** and **Meditation** as **clinical tools**, supported by **electroencephalogram (EEG)** data to prove their efficacy in **stress reduction**.
 
• **Sustainable Development:** By focusing on **mental well-being**, the conference directly contributes to **United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 3 (SDG 3)**: Good Health and Well-being.
</ul
